onboardingLanguageHint.en: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboardingLanguageHint.fr: Vous pourrez la changer à tout moment dans les Réglages.
onboardingLanguageHint.it: Puoi cambiarla in qualsiasi momento nelle Impostazioni.
onboardingLanguageHint.ro: O poți schimba oricând din Setări.
onboardingLanguageHint.sw: Unaweza kuibadilisha wakati wowote kwenye Mipangilio.
onboardingLanguageHint.tl: Mababago mo ito anumang oras sa Settings.

onboardingBibleBody.en: Pick the translation you read most. You can show a second one side by side.
onboardingBibleBody.fr: Choisissez la traduction que vous lisez le plus. Vous pouvez en afficher une seconde en parallèle.
onboardingBibleBody.it: Scegli la traduzione che leggi di più. Puoi affiancarne una seconda.
onboardingBibleBody.ro: Alege traducerea pe care o citești cel mai des. Poți afișa și una a doua alături.
onboardingBibleBody.sw: Chagua tafsiri unayosoma zaidi. Unaweza kuonyesha nyingine ya pili kando yake.
onboardingBibleBody.tl: Piliin ang saling madalas mong basahin. Maaari kang magpakita ng pangalawa nang magkatabi.

onboardingLookBody.en: Choose a page colour and text size. Everything can be fine-tuned later.
onboardingLookBody.fr: Choisissez une couleur de page et une taille de texte. Tout reste ajustable ensuite.
onboardingLookBody.it: Scegli il colore della pagina e la dimensione del testo. Potrai regolare tutto in seguito.
onboardingLookBody.ro: Alege culoarea paginii și mărimea textului. Totul se poate ajusta ulterior.
onboardingLookBody.sw: Chagua rangi ya ukurasa na ukubwa wa maandishi. Kila kitu kinaweza kurekebishwa baadaye.
onboardingLookBody.tl: Pumili ng kulay ng pahina at laki ng teksto. Maaaring ayusin ang lahat mamaya.

onboardingPreviewVerse.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
onboardingPreviewVerse.fr: Au commencement était la Parole, et la Parole était avec Dieu, et la Parole était Dieu.
onboardingPreviewVerse.it: Nel principio era la Parola, e la Parola era presso Dio, e la Parola era Dio.
onboardingPreviewVerse.ro: La început era Cuvântul, și Cuvântul era cu Dumnezeu, și Cuvântul era Dumnezeu.
onboardingPreviewVerse.sw: Hapo mwanzo kulikuwako Neno, naye Neno alikuwako kwa Mungu, naye Neno alikuwa Mungu.
onboardingPreviewVerse.tl: Nang pasimula ay ang Salita, at ang Salita ay kasama ng Diyos, at ang Salita ay Diyos.

onboardingFeaturesTitle.it: Tutto per il tuo cammino quotidiano
onboardingFeaturesTitle.ro: Tot ce-ți trebuie zi de zi
onboardingFeaturesTitle.sw: Kila kitu kwa safari yako ya kila siku
onboardingFeaturesTitle.tl: Lahat para sa iyong araw-araw na paglakad

onboardingFeatureWordBody.en: Read without distraction, with highlights, notes and bookmarks.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.fr: Lisez sans distraction, avec surlignages, notes et signets.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.it: Leggi senza distrazioni, con evidenziazioni, note e segnalibri.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.ro: Citește fără distrageri, cu evidențieri, notițe și semne de carte.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.sw: Soma bila usumbufu, ukiwa na alama, maelezo na vialamisho.
onboardingFeatureWordBody.tl: Magbasa nang walang abala, may highlight, tala at bookmark.

onboardingFeaturePlansBody.en: Chronological, thematic or your own — with gentle reminders.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.fr: Chronologiques, thématiques ou personnels — avec de doux rappels.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.it: Cronologici, tematici o personali — con promemoria discreti.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.ro: Cronologice, tematice sau proprii — cu mementouri discrete.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.sw: Ya mpangilio wa wakati, ya mada au yako mwenyewe — pamoja na vikumbusho vya upole.
onboardingFeaturePlansBody.tl: Kronolohikal, ayon sa paksa o sarili mo — may banayad na paalala.

onboardingFeatureStudyBody.en: Commentary, dictionary, Strong's and maps, right beside the text.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.fr: Commentaires, dictionnaire, Strong et cartes, juste à côté du texte.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.it: Commentari, dizionario, Strong e mappe, accanto al testo.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.ro: Comentarii, dicționar, Strong și hărți, chiar lângă text.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.sw: Maelezo, kamusi, Strong na ramani, kando ya maandiko.
onboardingFeatureStudyBody.tl: Komentaryo, diksyunaryo, Strong at mapa, katabi ng teksto.

onboardingFeatureSyncBody.en: Sign in any time to sync across your devices. No account needed to read.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.fr: Connectez-vous quand vous voulez pour synchroniser vos appareils. Aucun compte n'est requis pour lire.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.it: Accedi quando vuoi per sincronizzare i tuoi dispositivi. Per leggere non serve un account.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.ro: Conectează-te oricând pentru a sincroniza dispozitivele. Pentru citit nu ai nevoie de cont.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.sw: Ingia wakati wowote ili kusawazisha vifaa vyako. Huhitaji akaunti ili kusoma.
onboardingFeatureSyncBody.tl: Mag-sign in anumang oras para i-sync ang iyong mga device. Hindi kailangan ng account para magbasa.
